title: HA Decision Evidence Template (DEP-03)
description: Repository-only evidence template for the DEP-03 high-availability decision. The single-instance risk is explicit when applicable, RTO/RPO values remain PENDING (values may be present only as proposals, never as accepted commitments), and the approval slot is always PENDING. No HA, failover, or multi-zone capability is claimed by this template.

decisionState.description: The HA decision itself is PROPOSED or PENDING only.

haRequiredProposal.description: Proposed answer to whether HA (multi-zone / multi-instance) is needed for launch. A proposal only; nothing is implemented.

exists.description: Whether a single-instance risk applies to this component. Must be explicit when applicable.

status.description: Risk disposition is PENDING or PROPOSED only.
Approval status is always PENDING in repository-only foundations. A value of ACCEPTED or APPROVED is invalid.

owner.description: Owner identifier slot; remains null until the owner acts in writing.

date.description: Owner acceptance date slot; remains null until the owner acts.

value.description: Proposed target window in minutes. Null when no proposal exists yet. A value of 0 is invalid: RTO/RPO of zero cannot be evidenced by repository-only work and would imply accepted zero-downtime recovery.

status.description: Target window values are PENDING owner/SRE acceptance, never accepted commitments.
